title: Demo retrospective: what worked, what failed, action items
description: Produce board/docs/retro.md for this first demo build of the agent board: what worked / what failed / what surprised; escaped problems and rework observed while the board came together; action items each with owner and destination (skill update, backlog item, or process change). Include a short bug-triage table of any issues found (reproduce steps, severity, fix-forward plan). Governing skill: skills/sdlc/sdlc-maintenance/SKILL.md.
